headline: Is Brown & Brown (BRO) Stock A Bargain Or Fully Priced?
summary: Brown & Brown stock has delivered a 35.4% gain over the past five years, yet the latest checks send mixed valuation signals, with the intrinsic value estimate from the Excess Returns model pointing to upside while market multiples screen the shares as expensive. Over the past five years, Brown & Brown has returned 35.4%, which puts recent share price weakness into a longer term context for investors reviewing entry points. Expectations for continued low single digit organic revenue growth...
